title: Building a game dedicated to the beauty of Norway
author: Brave-History-6502
selftext:
I’ve been there twice and have memories that ai wanted to capture in a game. give it a try and let me know what you think: [https://fjordfall.fly.dev/?seed=20260821&region=fjellet&route=hovedvegen](https://fjordfall.fly.dev/?seed=20260821&region=fjellet&route=hovedvegen)

  
Heavy use of Claude, astra, blender, meshy, elevenlabs, and gpt image models.

comments.author: daddychewtoy
comments.body: im unable to play. it just sits and loads forever

comments.author: Den_er_da_hvid
comments.body: Takes extremly long time for loading.

replies.author: Brave-History-6502
replies.body:
Were you able to get in? It’s on a light server so I wonder if that is part
Of it…

replies.author: Den_er_da_hvid
replies.body:
Yes. I got into the game.   
Looks good, but it was difficult to understand how to play the stone game. Well not how to move stones around, but the endgoal of it. I tried to select the first big most obvous stone, but could not. Then I realised I had to press a button each time. some of the stones that was selected I could not see and I could not move the camera.   
I could not figure out when that minigame was won so I quit.

another observation on camera movement when running around. It is hard to constantly press mousebutton and move. are you going to use the mouse to interact with something? Else it would be better just to lock camera to the mouse

replies.author: Brave-History-6502
replies.body: I should def improve mouse camera interactivity! That mini game does need more work — idea was having different people contribute to building structures out of the stones— kind of like how you see rock stacks while hiking. Thought it could be a cool way to engage players in a world changing activity etc— would be cool if it was more clear

replies.author: Den_er_da_hvid
replies.body:
Oh, so it persists with other players?   
I was confused why the ui said things like How far you hiked "together" -and I am alone

replies.author: Brave-History-6502
replies.body: Yeah the game world is shared with anyone else who joins— but I haven’t pushed it out at all, it’s fun to get a friend to join at the same time and then you can interact/race etc
